working_memory.text: The upper path at Ganister Tarn has not been closed, despite a notice circulating online that says it has. What closed on 1 September is the short link between the north car park and the boathouse, for bank stabilisation. The upper path is open, though the surface above the scree is loose after the wet summer and the ranger service advises boots. The link is due to reopen before Christmas.
